title: Film Tone
description: A darkroom grade for a live source — sepia, black & white, negative or cyanotype, each with filmic contrast, brightness, film grain and a vignette. A per-pixel tone map over the shared source pipeline, so it filters the camera, a dropped photo or clip, the demo, or the layers below in the Mixer/Patch. Strength blends the tone back toward the original; grain is audio-mappable.
